scope.summary: Creates and edits Power Apps Canvas Apps through the Canvas Authoring MCP server, including app YAML validation, control discovery, API and connector discovery, data source schema discovery, and live coauthoring sync.

externalNetworkCalls: Connector and data source metadata services

servers.name: canvas-authoring
servers.purpose: Power Apps Canvas Authoring MCP server for app creation and coauthoring.

dependencies.name: Canvas Authoring MCP server (.NET runtime)
dependencies.description: Requires .NET runtime and dnx to install the prerelease Canvas Authoring MCP package.

dependencies.name: Power Apps environment with canvas app creation rights
dependencies.description: User must have Maker role or equivalent in the target environment. DLP policies affect which connectors are available to generated apps but do not block the plugin itself.

dependencies.name: Power Apps Studio coauthoring access
dependencies.description: Live coauthoring sync requires access to the Power Apps authoring service.

technologies.name: .NET
technologies.usedFor: Required runtime for dnx and Canvas Authoring MCP server.

exceptions: Canvas Apps use platform-native controls rather than React components. EDS should still influence accessibility and design guidance where applicable.

blockers: Internal owner and support channel are not assigned.
Skills, agents, and MCP configuration are not reviewed against Equinor guidance.
MCP server is installed through dnx with no explicit version pinning.
Production-system interaction is possible by default through live coauthoring and authoring service access.
Dependencies and environment prerequisites are not fully documented.
Technology Radar status is unknown for .NET in this context.

evidence.summary: Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-09-09 (canvas-apps v3.0.3). The canvas app generation workflow was reworked, `generate-canvas-app` and `references/TechnicalGuide.md` were removed, and lifecycle hooks (`hooks/hooks.json`, `hooks.json`, `hooks/inject-sync-reminder.cs`) were added — the hook runs `dotnet run` on a bundled C# file and needs review. `.mcp.json` no longer passes `--prerelease` or an explicit NuGet source, which clears the prerelease blocker; the package is still unpinned. The fork's stale flat `.mcp.json` shape was replaced with upstream's `mcpServers` envelope — the flat form predates upstream's own move to the standard MCP shape and was never an Equinor decision. Status remains `defer`.

Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-06-30 (canvas-apps v2.1.0). Added Open Plugins metadata (.plugin/plugin.json + marketplace entry) and bundled report-issue workflow content. No new scripts, hooks, or production interaction. The fork keeps its existing flat .mcp.json form; Copilot manifest blocker cleared and remaining blockers unchanged.

Re-reviewed after upstream sync 2026-06-09 (commit 08287fe). configure-canvas-mcp skill bumped to 2.1.0, adding optional auth_flow ('broker'|'browser') and login_hint parameters to the canvas-authoring MCP connect tool. Defaults are unchanged (first signed-in user, default auth flow); parameters are opt-in only when the user states a preference. No new scripts, dependencies, or production interaction. Blockers unchanged.
Documents Canvas Authoring MCP tools, coauthoring, connector discovery, and security notes.
Registers Canvas Authoring MCP through dnx, prerelease package, and NuGet source.

notes: Initial review record only. This record intentionally defers publication until detailed review evidence exists. Upstream sync 2026-06-09 added optional auth_flow/login_hint parameters to the Canvas Authoring MCP connect tool (configure-canvas-mcp v2.1.0); broker remains the default and browser sign-in is opt-in, so MCP governance posture is unchanged. Upstream sync 2026-06-30 added Open Plugins metadata and bundled report-issue workflow content with no new runtime behavior. Upstream sync 2026-09-09 (v3.0.3) reworked the generation workflow, dropped the prerelease NuGet flags, and introduced the first executable hook in this plugin.
